# Data Processing

## Package Installation & Loading
This section ensures that all necessary R packages for running this analysis & report are installed and loaded. If you are running this analysis for the first time, these packages will be installed automatically.

```{r}
required_packages <- c("data.table", "lubridate", "ggplot2", "cowplot")

# Check if packages are installed, install if not, then load them
for (pkg in required_packages) {
  if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg, dependencies = TRUE)
    library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}
```
